title: Positive Airway Pressure (PAP) Devices for Obstructive Sleep Apnea (Synthetic Health Plan — fictional policy)

sections.title: Synthetic Content Notice
sections.text: This document is a SYNTHETIC, fictional medical policy written for software testing and demonstration. It is not issued by any real health plan and must not be used for real coverage decisions.

sections.title: Initial Coverage (First 3 Months)
sections.text:
A continuous positive airway pressure device (E0601) is covered for an initial 3-month trial period when ALL of the following are met:

1. The member had a face-to-face clinical evaluation by the treating practitioner before the sleep test, documenting signs and symptoms of sleep-disordered breathing (for example, snoring, witnessed apneas, daytime sleepiness with an Epworth Sleepiness Scale score).
2. A facility-based polysomnogram or an approved home sleep apnea test demonstrates EITHER an apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) of 15 or more events per hour, OR an AHI of 5 to 14 events per hour with documented excessive daytime sleepiness, impaired cognition, mood disorder, insomnia, hypertension, ischemic heart disease, or history of stroke.
3. The member and/or caregiver received instruction on the proper use and care of the device.

A bi-level device without a backup rate (E0470) is covered when the above criteria are met AND a CPAP device has been tried and proven ineffective based on a therapeutic trial conducted in a facility or home setting.

sections.title: Continued Coverage Beyond 3 Months
sections.text:
Coverage continues beyond the initial 3 months only when, no sooner than the 31st day and no later than the 91st day after starting therapy, BOTH of the following are documented:

1. A clinical re-evaluation in which the treating practitioner documents that symptoms of obstructive sleep apnea are improved.
2. Objective evidence of adherence: use of the device for 4 or more hours per night on at least 70% of nights during a consecutive 30-day period within the first 3 months, obtained from the device's download data.

sections.title: Documentation Requirements
sections.text: Submit the face-to-face evaluation note, the complete sleep study report including AHI, the adherence download covering a consecutive 30-day period, and the re-evaluation note. Statements from the supplier alone are not sufficient documentation of medical necessity.

sections.title: Applicable Codes
sections.text: Device codes: E0601 (continuous positive airway pressure device), E0470 (respiratory assist device, bi-level pressure capability, without backup rate). Supporting diagnosis: G47.33 (obstructive sleep apnea, adult or pediatric).
